name: Aqua
note: Water, often the largest part of a liquid formula.

name: Glycerin
note: A syrupy ingredient that helps a product feel moist.

name: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice
note: Juice from the aloe plant, used in skin and hair formulas.

name: Panthenol
note: An ingredient used to soften the feel of a formula.

name: Tocopherol
note: A form of vitamin E used in creams and oils.

name: Citric Acid
note: An ingredient used to balance a formula.

name: Sodium Chloride
note: Salt, used to thicken some wash-off products.

name: Cetyl Alcohol
note: A waxy ingredient that makes creams feel smoother.

name: Stearyl Alcohol
note: A waxy ingredient that thickens creams.

name: Butyrospermum Parkii Butter
note: Shea butter, a fat from the shea nut used to soften skin.

name: Cocos Nucifera Oil
note: Oil from the coconut, used to soften skin and hair.

name: Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil
note: Oil from the jojoba seed, used to soften skin.

name: Xanthan Gum
note: A powder that thickens gels and creams.

name: Sodium Citrate
note: A salt used to balance a formula.

name: Squalane
note: A light oil used to soften skin.

name: Niacinamide
note: A form of vitamin B3 used in skin formulas.

name: Sodium Hyaluronate
note: A moisture-holding ingredient, also listed as hyaluronic acid.

name: Cetearyl Alcohol
note: A waxy ingredient that thickens creams.

name: Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride
note: A light oil used to soften skin.

name: Allantoin
note: An ingredient used in creams for its skin feel.

name: Chamomilla Recutita Flower Extract
note: An extract from the chamomile flower.

name: Avena Sativa Kernel Flour
note: Finely ground oat, used in skin formulas.

name: Sodium Laureth Sulfate
note: A cleansing agent that helps wash-off products foam.

name: Cocamidopropyl Betaine
note: A cleanser often used alongside other foaming agents.

name: Fragrance
note: A scent blend. Labels often do not name every material inside it.

name: Phenoxyethanol
note: An ingredient added so a product keeps for longer.

name: Methylparaben
note: An ingredient added so a product keeps for longer.

name: Propylparaben
note: An ingredient added so a product keeps for longer.

name: Limonene
note: A scent material from citrus, often listed beside fragrance.

name: Linalool
note: A floral scent material, often listed beside fragrance.

name: Benzyl Alcohol
note: Used as a scent material and to help a product keep.

name: Titanium Dioxide
note: A white powder used for colour and in some sunscreens.

name: Sodium Benzoate
note: An ingredient added so a product keeps for longer.

name: Alcohol Denat.
note: A drying alcohol, not the waxy alcohols used to thicken creams.

name: Tetrasodium EDTA
note: An ingredient that binds minerals so a formula stays stable.

name: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate
note: A strong cleansing agent used to make foam in wash-off products.

name: Triclosan
note: An antibacterial ingredient used in some washes.

name: Formaldehyde
note: Listed on some labels as a preservative.

name: DMDM Hydantoin
note: An ingredient added so a product keeps. These rules group it with formaldehyde releasers.

name: Methylisothiazolinone
note: An ingredient added so a product keeps for longer.

name: Oxybenzone
note: A sunscreen filter, also called benzophenone-3.

name: Hydroquinone
note: An ingredient used in some products that lighten the look of skin.

name: BHA
note: Butylated hydroxyanisole, added to keep oils from going off.

name: Coal Tar
note: A dark ingredient from coal, used in some shampoos.
